decisions.reason: The product has remained on the website and is backed by a quantified customer value case of more than €600,000 annual savings, so its upside is evidenced and worth preserving.
As a close extension of the core range that was still presented on its own page in 2024, it appears inexpensive to keep on offer while the firm continues to learn about demand in a growing market.
The concept shows continued market presence plus a named customer investment and quantified savings, indicating that uncertainty has resolved positively enough to justify staying in the portfolio.
This 2024 launch is still too new to judge conclusively, and for a growing machinery firm the cost of keeping an adjacent shredder option open is likely low relative to its potential.
The 2024 mobile spiral shaft screens fit the firm's modular environmental-technology direction, and with limited time since launch there is not yet enough negative evidence to justify abandonment.
